issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Parallel Chunk Download for UploadPanorama Worker

Changes

  • Created DownloadFileParallel in src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/parallel_download.go providing multi-connection chunked downloading via HTTP Range: bytes=start-end.
  • Replaced os/exec curl command in src/Worker/UploadPanorama/UploadPanorama.go with PostFunctions.DownloadFileParallel.
  • Implemented custom http.Transport with dynamic DialContext routing to support serverIp target routing and InsecureSkipVerify TLS (replacing curl's --resolve and -k).
  • Implemented file probing (HEAD + GET Range: bytes=0-0) with graceful zero-waste fallback to single-stream downloading when Range is unsupported or file is small (< 2 MB).
  • Implemented concurrent non-overlapping chunk writes using os.File.WriteAt after pre-allocating the file via Truncate.
  • Added per-chunk retry logic (up to 3 attempts) with byte offset resumption and exponential backoff.
  • Added background progress reporter logging download progress (percent, MB, and MB/s) every 3 seconds.
  • Added support for UPLOAD_DOWNLOAD_CONCURRENCY environment variable (default: 8 connections).
  • Added comprehensive unit tests in src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/parallel_download_test.go.

issues.display_title: Issue #515: Event-Driven Add Post Complete (Eliminate Race Condition)
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Event-Driven Add Post Complete (Eliminate Race Condition)

Architecture Change

Before (Polling)

Client --> /v1/posts/complete --> RabbitMQ(_add_post_complete) --> PostComplete worker
                                                                      |
                                                                      v
                                                              Poll Redis every 5s
                                                              (max 100x = ~8.3 min)
                                                                      |
                                                            +---------+---------+
                                                            |                   |
                                                       All ready?          Limit reached?
                                                            |                   |
                                                       Process post      Delete post + notify

After (Event-Driven)

Client --> /v1/posts/complete --> Save payload to Redis
                                  |
                                  +--> All files already ready? (edge case)
                                       YES --> TryAcquirePostCompleteTrigger (SETNX)
                                               --> Publish to RabbitMQ
                                       NO  --> Wait for UploadPanorama worker

UploadPanorama worker (per file):
    Set Redis status = "success"
        |
        v
    CheckAllPanoramaReady? AND Payload exists?
        |
        YES --> TryAcquirePostCompleteTrigger (SETNX)
                --> Only ONE winner publishes to RabbitMQ(_add_post_complete)
        NO  --> Skip (more files pending or client hasn't hit /complete yet)

PostComplete worker:
    Consume message --> Process directly (all files guaranteed ready)
    No polling, no sleep, no requeue.

Changes

1. src/Utils/Redis/panorama_cache.go -- New Redis Functions

Added 6 new functions and TTL constants:

  • SavePostCompletePayload(sid, payload) -- Stores the base64-encoded payload from /v1/posts/complete with 24h TTL. Key: {prefix}_post_complete_payload:{sid}.
  • GetPostCompletePayload(sid) -- Retrieves the stored payload.
  • DeletePostCompletePayload(sid) -- Removes the payload after successful processing.
  • CheckAllPanoramaReady(sid) -- Uses SCAN + MGET to check if all panorama status keys for a SID have value "success". Returns (allReady bool, totalFiles int).
  • TryAcquirePostCompleteTrigger(sid) -- Uses SETNX to atomically claim the right to trigger PostComplete. Only the first caller gets true. Key: {prefix}_post_complete_trigger_lock:{sid}.
  • DeletePostCompleteTriggerLock(sid) -- Cleans up the trigger lock after processing.

Added TTL to existing function:

  • SetPanoramaStatus() -- Changed from TTL=0 (no expiry) to TTL=24h to prevent orphaned keys.

2. src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go -- Modified Handler

AddPostCompleteV1 changes:

  • DB update moved before Redis/RabbitMQ operations -- is_uploading=false, is_processing=true is now set first, preventing the "publish before DB update" crash window.
  • Payload saved to Redis instead of publishing directly to RabbitMQ. The UploadPanorama worker will retrieve this payload and trigger PostComplete when ready.
  • Edge case check -- After saving the payload, immediately checks CheckAllPanoramaReady. If all files are already uploaded (small files finish before client hits /complete), triggers PostComplete via TryAcquirePostCompleteTrigger + RabbitMQ.Publish.
  • Fixed incorrect comment // UPLOAD PANORAMA POST V1 to // ADD POST COMPLETE V1.

3. src/Worker/UploadPanorama/UploadPanorama.go -- Event-Driven Trigger

After setting Redis.SetPanoramaStatus(slug, uName, "success"), added:

  • Check CheckAllPanoramaReady(slug) -- are all files for this SID now "success"?
  • Check GetPostCompletePayload(slug) -- has the client submitted the complete payload?
  • If both conditions met: TryAcquirePostCompleteTrigger(slug) -- atomic SETNX lock.
    • Winner: publishes payload to _add_post_complete queue.
    • Loser: logs skip message (another worker already triggered it).
    • On publish failure: releases the lock via DeletePostCompleteTriggerLock so it can be retried.

4. src/Worker/PostComplete/PostComplete.go -- Removed Polling

Removed:

  • Entire polling/requeue loop (Redis status checking, time.Sleep(5s), delivery.Reject(true), requeue counter logic).
  • sendPostFailure() function (was called when requeue limit reached -- no longer applicable).
  • CheckAndSetPanoramaStatus() function (filesystem fallback check -- no longer needed).

Changed:

  • Consumer now processes messages directly without any readiness checks.
  • Redis panorama cleanup moved outside if elastic {} block so both publish and draft paths clean up their keys.
  • Added DeletePostCompletePayload(sid) and DeletePostCompleteTriggerLock(sid) at the end of the success path.
  • Removed duplicate DeleteRequeueStatus call (was called both inside if elastic {} and outside).

Files

  • src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go
  • src/Worker/UploadPanorama/UploadPanorama.go
  • src/Worker/PostComplete/PostComplete.go

Item Result

Reliability & Cleanup Guaranteed exactly-once execution; all keys (panorama_status, payload, trigger_lock) scoped with 24h TTL; cleanup unified for publish and draft flows

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

  • Root Cause & Objective:
    Previously, AddPostCompleteV1 pushed directly to RabbitMQ, causing PostComplete to sleep 5s and poll Redis up to 100 times (~8.3 min). Large uploads exceeding this threshold were deleted, while sleeps blocked single worker consumers. Furthermore, pushing before the DB update caused "No post found" crashes.
  • Changes Verified in Repository:
    1. Database Update Order Fixed (PostsHandlers.go):
      • is_uploading = false and is_processing = true updated in DB before payload caching and message publishing.
    2. Atomic Trigger Acquisition via Redis SETNX (panorama_cache.go):
      • TryAcquirePostCompleteTrigger: Atomically claims trigger execution right with SETNX.
      • SavePostCompletePayload & GetPostCompletePayload: Holds base64 payload with 24h TTL until files finish.
      • CheckAllPanoramaReady: Verifies all uploaded panorama files carry "success" status.
    3. Event-Driven Dispatch (UploadPanorama.go):
      • The worker that finishes the last pending panorama file claims the SETNX lock and triggers _add_post_complete.
    4. Eliminated Polling & Requeue Overhead (PostComplete.go):
      • Completely removed time.Sleep(5s) and retry limits.
      • Direct non-blocking post processing since all files are guaranteed ready when consumed.
      • Unified Redis key cleanup across both draft and publish flows.
    5. Unit Test & Build Verification:

      • Worker binaries for UploadPanorama and PostComplete build cleanly.

Verified Lock Implementation

// Atomic lock ensuring exactly-once PostComplete dispatch
func TryAcquirePostCompleteTrigger(sid string) bool {
	ctx, cancel := redisCtx()
	defer cancel()

	key := fmt.Sprintf("%s_post_complete_trigger_lock:%s", os.Getenv("PREFIX"), sid)
	success, err := RedisClient.SetNX(ctx, key, "1", 24*time.Hour).Result()
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return success
}

Implementation: Embed Keycloak Refresh Token in JWT Claims and Extract During Logout

Summary

Implemented automatic Keycloak SSO session termination by embedding the Keycloak refresh_token inside the Panorra Hasura JWT payload during Keycloak login. During logout, if refresh_token is not explicitly provided in the request body or query, it is automatically extracted from the JWT token (via Authorization header, Fiber locals, or body token) to terminate the Keycloak SSO session.

  • ExtractKeycloakRefreshToken(c *fiber.Ctx, bodyRefreshToken, bodyToken string) string:

// Cascading resolution from body, query, locals, and Authorization header
func ExtractKeycloakRefreshToken(c *fiber.Ctx, bodyRefreshToken, bodyToken string) string {
	if bodyRefreshToken != "" {
		return bodyRefreshToken
	}
	if q := c.Query("refresh_token"); q != "" {

	// Extract from Fiber locals or Authorization Bearer JWT
	if localClaim := c.Locals("keycloak"); localClaim != nil {
		if token := ExtractRefreshTokenFromClaim(localClaim); token != "" {
			return token
		}
	}
	return ""
}

issues.display_title: Issue #537: Optimize Performance, Concurrency, and Resource Usage Across API Infrastructure
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Optimize Performance, Concurrency, and Resource Usage Across API Infrastructure

Summary

Refactored critical performance, resource management, and concurrency bottlenecks across src/Middleware/, src/Action/V2/Users/, src/Utils/RabbitMQ/, src/Utils/Redis/, and src/Utils/Functions/:

  1. Redis Logger Middleware:

    • Batched Incr and Expire commands into a single TCP round-trip using Redis Pipeline (rdb.Pipeline()).
    • Added a 250ms deadline timeout context (redisLoggerTimeout) to ensure slow Redis calls never stall HTTP requests.
    • Guarded against nil Redis client pointers to eliminate runtime panics in uninitialized environments.

  2. Regex Precompilation:

    • Swapped dynamic on-the-fly regexp.MatchString in src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile.go with precompiled Patterns.Username and Patterns.FullnameSpecialChars from src/Utils/Patterns.
    • Removed unused "regexp" import from EditProfile.go.

  3. Reused Thread-Safe RabbitMQ Publisher Channel:

    • Replaced per-message AMQP channel creation (conn.Channel() and ch.Close()) in src/Utils/RabbitMQ/RabbitMQ.go with a reusable, mutex-protected channel (pubChannel).
    • Implemented automatic recovery: if channel is closed or publish fails, the channel is closed, invalidated, and reopened with a one-time retry.
    • Invalidates cached publisher channel on connection reconnects.

  4. Redis Cache Nil Guards & Dual Format Decoding:

    • Added nil checks to ReplaceUserDetails, ReplaceDeactiveUser, SuggestionUser, and ListBlockUser in src/Utils/Redis/user_cache.go.
    • In UserDatas (src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go), added a 2-second timeout context and nil check for RedisClient.
    • Intercepted "User Not Found" before base64 decoding to return accurate error payloads.
    • Added dual format decoding to support both base64-encoded JSON and direct raw JSON strings.

  5. Shared Outbound HTTP Client:

    • Replaced zero-timeout http.Get(...) in src/Utils/Functions/response.go with defaultHTTPClient configured with a 10-second timeout.
    • Unified ReCaptcha and ReCaptchaSlim into a shared verifyCaptcha helper.

Files Updated

1. src/Middleware/RedisLogger.go

  • Added const redisLoggerTimeout = 250 * time.Millisecond.
  • Checked if rdb == nil before attaching handler.
  • Converted rdb.Incr + rdb.Expire sequence to rdb.Pipeline().

2. src/Middleware/RedisLogger_test.go

  • Added TestRedisLogger_NilClientDoesNotPanic to verify nil client safety.
  • Added TestRedisLogger_UnreachableClientFailsGracefully to ensure timeout and non-blocking handler execution.

3. src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile.go

  • Replaced regexp.MatchString with Patterns.Username.MatchString and Patterns.FullnameSpecialChars.MatchString.
  • Cleaned up "regexp" import.

4. src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile_test.go

  • Added TestValidLocation with table-driven test cases covering edge cases (spaces, digit-only, control characters, tags, rune boundaries).

5. src/Utils/RabbitMQ/RabbitMQ.go

  • Added pubChannel *amqp.Channel and pubChannelMu sync.Mutex.
  • In GetConnection(), safely closed and cleared pubChannel when reconnecting.
  • In Publish(), reused pubChannel with automatic reconnect retry.

6. src/Utils/RabbitMQ/connection_test.go

  • Added TestPublishUnreachableReturnsError to verify error propagation when connection is unavailable.

7. src/Utils/Redis/user_cache.go

  • Added if RedisClient != nil checks across cache setter operations.

8. src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go

  • Added 2-second timeout context for Redis retrieval.
  • Added nil check for Redis.RedisClient.
  • Implemented direct check for "User Not Found".
  • Added support for both base64-encoded JSON and raw JSON byte slices.

9. src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions_test.go

  • Added TestDecodeUserDetail_Base64AndRawJSON verifying decoding consistency.

10. src/Utils/Functions/response.go

  • Introduced defaultHTTPClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}.
  • Added verifyCaptcha(secret, input string) bool.
  • Updated MakeGetCRULRequest to use defaultHTTPClient.

Problem

Audit of panorra-api-go-new identified several performance bottlenecks, unbounded resources, and latency overheads in core request handling and background messaging paths:

  1. Redis Logger Middleware Overhead:
    Every incoming HTTP request executed two sequential synchronous Redis round-trips (rdb.Incr followed by rdb.Expire) using an unbounded context.Background(). If Redis experienced latency spikes, all API endpoints slowed down. Additionally, if the Redis client was not initialized, it triggered a nil pointer dereference panic.

  2. Repetitive Regex Compilation in Handlers:
    src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile.go compiled regular expressions dynamically via regexp.MatchString on every username and fullname validation, creating unnecessary AST parsing and memory allocation churn instead of leveraging precompiled patterns.

  3. Ephemeral RabbitMQ Publisher Channels:
    RabbitMQ.Publish opened and closed a brand new AMQP channel (conn.Channel() and ch.Close()) on every single published message. This introduced four AMQP network RPC round-trips (channel.open, channel.open-ok, channel.close, channel.close-ok) per event.

  4. Redis Cache Handling & Panic Vulnerabilities:
    UserDatas in UsersFunctions.go retrieved user caches using an unbounded context.Background() with no nil check on RedisClient. In addition, if user lookup failed, ReplaceUserDetails returned "User Not Found", which caused base64.DecodeString to fail with a confusing "Error decoding base64" message. Multiple Redis write helpers also lacked nil guards.

  5. Unbounded Outbound HTTP Requests:

Implementation: Refactor Image Serving with Zero-Copy Streaming and Path Traversal Protection

Summary

  1. Replaced os.ReadFile with c.SendStream:

    • In src/Routes/V1/Routes.go, refactored /img/:ec/:file and /img/attachments/:action/:file to serve images via c.SendStream(f) using opened file descriptors (*os.File) instead of reading entire files into RAM via os.ReadFile.

func isPathUnderBase(baseDir, targetPath string) bool {
    cleanBase := filepath.Clean(baseDir)
    cleanTarget := filepath.Clean(targetPath)

}

issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Hardening Unsafe Type Assertions in PostsHandlers

Summary

Hardened all unsafe type assertions and unmarshaling access points in src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go:

  1. Protected Payload Extraction (UploadPanoramaPostV1):

    • Added validation check !okData || dataStr == "" preventing empty payload publishing to RabbitMQ.

  2. Hardened Type Assertions (AddPostCompleteV1):

    • defaultSettings & isPost: Replaced direct type casting with safe assertion okDefault and empty checks, returning 400 Bad Request ("Required Body") instead of panicking when default is nil or not a JSON map.
    • action: Added safe string assertion and fallback to "draft".
    • multiple: Added safe slice assertion okMultiples ensuring multiples is a valid slice with len > 0.
    • panorama: Added parsePanoramaDefault helper to safely parse float64, float32, int, and int64 representations without type-assertion panics.
    • u_name: Added safe slice assertion okUNames before calculating bounds check panoramaDefault > float64(len(uNames)).
    • lastLogin & userId: Guarded extraction from userDatas map with safe string assertions.

  3. Guarded Database Nil Checks in Error Logging & Cache:

    • In src/Utils/Functions/response.go (SaveLogErr): Added guard if Config.DB == nil { return nil } preventing nil pointer panics during uninitialized database states.
    • In src/Utils/Redis/user_cache.go (ReplaceUserDetails): Added guard if Config.DB == nil { return "User Not Found" }.

  4. Created Automated Tests:

    • Created src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers_test.go covering:
      • TestParsePanoramaDefault: Verifying float, int, string, and nil inputs.
      • TestUploadPanoramaPostV1_InvalidJSON: Verifying invalid JSON rejection.
      • TestUploadPanoramaPostV1_EmptyData: Verifying empty data rejection.
      • TestAddPostCompleteV1_InvalidJSON: Verifying invalid body rejection.
      • TestAddPostCompleteV1_EmptyData: Verifying empty data rejection.
      • TestAddPostCompleteV1_InvalidBase64: Verifying malformed base64 rejection.
      • TestAddPostCompleteV1_InvalidInnerJSON: Verifying inner payload JSON rejection.
      • TestAddPostCompleteV1_MissingDefaultDoesNotPanic: Verifying that missing/nil default object returns a clean error response without panicking.

Files Updated

1. Controllers

  • src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go:
    • Added parsePanoramaDefault(val interface{}) (float64, bool).
    • Added guards for dataStr, defaultSettings, isPost, action, multiples, panoramaDefault, uNames, and userDatas.

    • Added if Config.DB == nil { return nil } in SaveLogErr.

Problem

In src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go, the handler AddPostCompleteV1 performs direct unchecked type assertions on decoded request payloads (postsData map) and user session dictionaries (userDatas map):

  1. defaultSettings := postsData["default"].(map[string]interface{}): Panics if default is nil, primitive, or omitted.
  2. isPost := postsData["is_post"].(string): Panics if is_post is nil or non-string.
  3. action := postsData["action"].(string): Panics if action is nil or non-string.
  4. multiples := postsData["multiple"].([]interface{}): Panics if multiple is nil or not a slice.
  5. panoramaDefault = defaultSettings["panorama"].(float64): Panics if panorama is nil or passed as an integer/string.
  6. postsData["u_name"].([]interface{}): Panics if u_name is nil or not a slice.
  7. userDatas["last_login"].(string) and userDatas["user_id"].(string): Panics if session values are missing or not string.

Any malformed or malicious payload targeting /v1/posts/complete triggers an unhandled Go runtime panic (panic: interface conversion: interface {} is nil, not ...), terminating the request abruptly and causing HTTP 500 crashes instead of structured 400 Bad Request validation errors.

Scope

  1. Safe Type Guarding in src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go:

    • Add two-value type assertion checks (val, ok := ...) for default, is_post, action, multiple, u_name, last_login, and user_id.
    • Add flexible numeric parsing for panorama allowing both float64, integer, and string representations.
    • Return clean 400 Bad Request responses with descriptive validation messages whenever required fields are absent or of unexpected types.

  2. Automated Unit Testing (src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers_test.go):

    • Test invalid JSON body.
    • Test empty base64 payload.
    • Test corrupted base64 data.
    • Test payload with missing/nil default object (ensuring no panic).
    • Test payload with missing/nil is_post string (ensuring no panic).
    • Test payload with invalid action value (ensuring no panic).
    • Test payload with missing/nil multiple slice (ensuring no panic).
    • Test payload with missing/nil u_name slice (ensuring no panic).

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • Valid client requests produce the exact same responses, headers, and behavior as before.
    • Invalid client requests receive well-formed JSON error envelopes (Functions.ErrorResponse) instead of unhandled runtime panics.

  • All malformed payload scenarios return standard 400 Bad Request without triggering panics.
